item.title: ‘Saturday Night Live UK’: Where to Watch the British Version of the Sketch Comedy Show Online
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we bring you the latest news and updates from the world of entertainment. Today, we're talking about a big milestone for Saturday Night Live - it's officially expanding outside of the United States to the United Kingdom with Saturday Night Live UK."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The new sketch comedy show has tapped White Lotus actress Aimee Lou Wood to host, and British singer/songwriter MEEK is set to perform as musical guest. If you're in the UK, you can catch the show live on Sky UK on May 2nd at 10 p.m. BST. And if you're in the US, you can watch it on Peacock the following day, May 3rd, at 9 p.m. ET/6 p.m. PT."
[Short music transition]
Host: "But here's the thing - you don't have to pay for a subscription to watch it. You can sign up for a 30-day free trial to Walmart+, which includes access to Peacock, and stream the show online for free. Alternatively, you can subscribe to Peacock directly for $10.99 per month. And if you want to watch it live, you can use Sky Stream with ExpressVPN, starting at just $2.79 per month."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The show features a talented cast of British comedy actors and comedians, including Hammed Animashaun, Ayoade Bamgboye, and Emma Sidi, among others. And with Aimee Lou Wood and MEEK on board, it's shaping up to be a fantastic episode. So mark your calendars and get ready to watch Saturday Night Live UK."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next one."
